page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ae.32xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization. Powered by an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz, it provides 128 dedicated vCPUs. The instance is paired with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Network performance features a high baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, though it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This instance configuration does not include local disk storage or dedicated GPU hardware accelerators, requiring cloud-attached network storage for persistent disk needs. The 1:2 RAM-to-vCPU ratio prioritizes core density over large memory footprints. This hardware design offers qualitative cost efficiency for execution environments that require high parallel CPU throughput without paying for excess RAM capacity. The ecs.c8ae.32xlarge is suited for compute-bound tasks including batch processing, high-performance computing (HPC) simulations, software compilation, and high-throughput application tiers.
